blockers.why: No new person after 60% fails: the sister first appears after roughly 64% and becomes the reason for the climactic choice.
blockers.fix: Plant her before halfway, for example at 4:15: "His phone lights up: SISTER. He turns it face down."

blockers.quote: Around you, every tag in the court dips a point, 99 to 98, because one person did a thing nobody had seen.
blockers.why: No new power rule after halfway fails: one person's surprise changing everyone else's forecast is a new systemic mechanic introduced at the peak.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "Around you, every other tag stays fixed. Every face turns toward the two crimson cards."

blockers.quote: Scientists gave 160 teams thousands of facts about thousands of families and asked them to predict how the children's lives would turn out; the best models were only slightly better than a simple guess from four facts (c24).
blockers.why: Check #7 Misconception first fails: a second number-heavy finding arrives before the brain-scan finding lands on you.
blockers.fix: Cut this finding here. Land the first fact immediately: "Brain scans managed about sixty. The card over you says ninety-nine. So where did the rest come from?"

suggestions.quote: A paper flap inside 0.5 s: a tag dropping.
suggestions.fix: Make the cause precede the effect: the worker clips the lamp at 0:00, it blinks by 0:00.5, and then the first tag drops.

suggestions.quote: The exam hall: GUESSES C 76% over forty heads; the teacher reads the room instead of the papers. The penalty kick: the striker's tag KICKS LEFT 91%; the keeper saves every one in the league
suggestions.fix: Cut both examples and move directly from the ruined date to the pickpocket, turning private awkwardness into public punishment instead of extending the montage.

suggestions.quote: The evidence, one at a time: an American insurer already cuts your price if it can watch you drive, and about two drivers in ten see it rise (c16); within six months the watched drivers were braking hard about a fifth less often (c17).
suggestions.fix: Keep only the tracked-drivers result, then immediately run the board backward; the insurer setup repeats the fictional rule after the emotional peak.

keep.quote: He reads the sixty-two. He shuts his mouth. He counts coins instead.
You've put that key in your pocket a thousand times. Tonight it's the first time you've locked something away from him.
It never got better at seeing you. You got better at being seen.
